question:
How many cycles are not pedals?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3892f9e9dbbc731eb9c626305ff84b53f6b88e944e8433db11fe141c933d5bcb.png]
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2cfbc34ad7f81bea552a612dd193c5f8e7aa3697acc043309bf1ad0f70ed1d25.png] 

The number of cycles which are not pedals = (6 + 5) = 11

Hence, the correct answer is **"11"**.
